title: DeviceUpserted
description: A device was registered or came back after removal, or its push registration changed or was cleared (signing out clears it). `side` is the side its app signed in to: a push for one side goes only to that side's devices; a device without it, not signed in since sides were kept, hears every side.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

push_token.description: Where FCM delivers this device's pushes: a registration token or a Firebase Installation ID, as `push_kind` says; null when the device can no longer be pushed.

push_kind.title: PushKind
push_kind.description: What `push_token` holds: `token`, an FCM registration token (sent as `message.token`), or `fid`, a Firebase Installation ID (sent as `message.fid`). Absent on events from before it was kept: `token`.

notifications_enabled.description: Whether the phone lets the app show notifications, as the app last said; null when it has not said. FCM accepts a push the phone will not show, so `false` counts the device as unreachable.

push_updated_at.description: When the app last uploaded its push registration; a registration not renewed for long is stale.

side.title: MembershipSide
side.description: A side of the market: `shipper`, `carrier`, or `platform` for GoWay's own staff.
